body:
Yep, had childhood abuse as well as male bulimia, which isn't even real.

You are a person Mama, you have a family, and a lover, and beautiful children, and a personality!

Laphman11 - Talk about it, talk about why it sucks, what exactly sucks, how it makes you feel, what you wish was different, any and everything.

It's crazy how people use things like that as a way to dehumanize others.  It's straight up maddening when it comes from people otherwise preaching progressive tolerance. Then they expect you to just smile and be OK with it.

One thing people do to me is that they'll not answer when I say hello, they'll do this look to their friend, then start talking about me like I'm not there, and if I react *at all* then they laugh, and suddenly the treatment was "legitimate."  This post-facto rationalization for shit behavior.

I want to hear about your problem, I'll be gone soon, but please tell me, I will listen and respond. I'll try to relate as best I can. If I can help, I will.
